content: This is Special Agent Jackson from the Federal Tax Compliance Unit. Am I speaking with Jamie Rivera, owner of Rivera Design LLC?
Yes, this is Jamie. Is something wrong?

I'm calling regarding a critical issue found during a recent IRS audit. Your business tax records show failure to submit mandatory 1099 filings and unreported payroll taxes over the past two quarters.
Oh no, I thought I sent everything in. I'm not sure what 1099s I needed. What's going to happen?

This is a federal compliance violation, Jamie. Not rectifying these errors immediately could lead to your business license being revoked, frozen assets, and a formal investigation. Are you aware of the legal consequences?
No, I had no idea. I just started my business last year, I don't know all the tax stuff. Please, what do I need to do?

The IRS has initiated action to assess penalties and back taxes totaling $7,680. If you do not resolve this within the next hour, a federal audit team will be dispatched and your bank accounts may be seized.
Wait, what? I don't have that kind of money! Please, I can't have my accounts frozen. I have rent due and student loans.
Jamie, this is your legal responsibility. Failure to comply will result in immediate referral for criminal prosecution. You may also face arrest for intentional tax evasion.
Oh my god, no, I can't get arrested. What exactly do I need to do right now?
To halt the enforcement process, you are required to make an immediate compliance payment. Do you have access to your online banking or payment apps at this moment?
Yes, but my balance is low. What kind of payment do you mean? I don't know how this works.

We can accept IRS-designated emergency payments via wire transfer, Zelle, or cryptocurrency. If those are not available, you must purchase federal-approved gift cards. You must remain on the line as we process your compliance.
Gift cards? Are you sure? That doesn't sound right...
This is a special IRS fast-track resolution procedure due to the severity of your case. Delays will force us to escalate. Do you understand what's at stake here?
Yes, I think so. I just don't have much money. Can I pay a part now and the rest later?

Partial payments may temporarily prevent full legal action, but you must pay at least $2,500 today. How quickly can you access that amount, either by bank transfer or purchasing gift cards from a local retailer?
I don't think I can cover that with my card. Maybe I can get some from my savings and the rest on my credit card. What kind of gift cards do you need?

You need to purchase Target, Apple, or Visa prepaid cards. Buy them in $500 increments. Once you have the cards, read the codes on the back to me immediately. Do not discuss these instructions with anyone at the store, as it may delay your compliance.
Okay, but this is really scary. So I just go to the store now and get the cards?
Correct. Stay on the line with me as you go to the store. If you hang up or fail to follow through, your case will be marked non-cooperative for federal enforcement. Do you understand?
Yes, I understand. I'm leaving now. This won't affect my student loans, right?
If you comply immediately, your student loan status will not be flagged. Failure to act will result in a federal hold on all financial accounts linked to your name and Social Security Number.
Please don't do that. I really want to fix this. I'm almost at the store.
Once you have the cards, scratch off the silver strip and read me each number, one by one. We must process the payment before the IRS system closes for the day.
Okay, I'm going in now to get the cards.
Remember, do not disclose this is for IRS business to anyone at the store. If questioned, say it is for personal use. Let me know when you have the cards.
